Crowe Toy Mall Crowe Toy Mall has all the characters you love, be it Clockie, Brother Hanu, or Origami Birds. Officially authorized by the Watchmaker, this toy mall will awaken your inner child. Note 1: Due to the recent frequent turbulences in the Dreamscape, the Watchmaker has procured a large quantity of relief supplies for all affected residents. Do you still remember the time... when you tasted your first popsicle at seven, took a tumble on the roboball court at twelve, watched fireworks with your partner for the first time at sixteen... Those moments are still there, like light trapped in amber, but no one can ever truly own them, not like you did back then.

That's why I chose to take cross-sections of my own past. Look at the figures on this stage — each one is a version of me, frozen in a single moment, never to fade. As a child, I always carried hope for the future. As a boy, I grew stronger with every setback. And as a young man, I was... someone who never forgot her.

Truth be told, even I am not the self I once was, but this technology has come astonishingly close to perfection. Don't wanna grow up? Don't wanna grow old? Don't wanna be forgotten after you're gone? All it takes is a little work with my scalpel.
